meta.title: A330 Phase Flows
meta.sources: A330P FCOM R17 PRO-NOR / PRO-ABN / PRO-NOR-SUP-SEC; QRH R35 22.02A; FCTM R6 PR-NP-CL, PR-AEP; FOM 125.3 5.5.15, 5.7.4, 6.3, 6.4, 11.2; PRC 8/31/26 p1, p2; FCOM PRO-SPO-40A
meta.builders: box(t,s,r,call,q) fmc(t,s,r,q) sub(t,c) trig(t,r) cl(t,w,bold,cc) book(t,s) note(t) S(h,c,items,cite,appr); q = quote + [ref]
meta.roles: C=CM1 (CA seat) F=CM2 (FO seat) PF PM B=both; appr: all | ILS | ILScat (CAT II/III) | RNP | NPA
meta.normal_source: data/flows.json (quickref order and role) cross-checked to FCOM PRO-NOR idents; quotes are literal extract text

items.s: Obstructions near the aircraft · Engineering activity · Refueling activity
items.quote: When the flight crew arrives at the aircraft, they must check for, or be informed of any obstructions near the aircraft, engineering activity, or refueling activity, etc.

items.s: WHEEL CHOCKS ... CHECK
items.quote: If the wheel chocks are not in position, the flight crew must check that the parking brake is set with sufficient accumulator pressure.

items.s: LANDING GEAR DOORS ... CHECK POSITION
items.quote: If any landing gear door is open, do not pressurize the hydraulic systems until clearance is obtained from ground personnel.

items.s: APU AREA ... CHECK
items.quote: Observe that the APU inlet and outlet are clear.

items.t: Items marked * are the only steps after a transit stop without flight crew change.
ENG masters OFF · ENG START NORM
items.s: ENG 1, 2 MASTERS LEVERS ... OFF · ENG START selector ... NORM
items.quote: ENG 1, 2 MASTERS LEVERS ... OFF CM2 ENG START selector ... NORM CM2

items.s: WXR/PWS sw ... OFF · CAPT and F/O DISPLAY mode selectors ... OFF · GAIN ... AUTO · TURB ... AUTO
items.quote: * WXR/PWS sw ... OFF CM2 * CAPT DISPLAY mode selector ... OFF CM2 * F/O DISPLAY mode selector ... OFF CM2 * GAIN knob ... AUTO CM2 * TURB sw ... AUTO CM2

items.s: L/G lever ... DOWN
items.quote: L/G lever ... DOWN CM2

items.s: Both WIPER selectors ... OFF
items.quote: Both WIPER selectors ... OFF CM2

items.s: Not supplied 6 h or more: BAT 1, BAT 2, APU BAT ... CHECK OFF · VOLTAGE ... CHECK ABOVE 25.5 V · BAT 1, BAT 2, APU BAT pb-sw ... AUTO · EXT PWR pb ... ON · already supplied: BAT pb-sw ... AUTO · voltage ... CHECK ABOVE 23.5 V · EXT PWR pb ... ON
items.quote: Battery voltage above 25.5 V ensures a charge above 50 %. After the check, the selector should remain on the APU position to avoid discharge of BAT 1 or 2.

items.s: Green NAV light ... CHECK OFF · COM FREQUENCIES ... TUNE · ACP: INT knob ... PRESS OUT/VOLUME CHECK · VHF ... CHECK
items.quote: Use VHF 1 for ATC (only VHF 1 is available in emergency electrical configuration), VHF 2 for ATIS and company frequencies. VHF 3 is normally devoted to ACARS.

items.s: APU FIRE pb-sw ... CHECK IN and GUARDED · APU AGENT light ... CHECK OFF · APU FIRE TEST pb ... PRESS and MAINTAIN
items.quote: APU FIRE TEST pb ... PRESS and MAINTAIN CM2

items.s: APU MASTER SW pb-sw ... ON · APU pb (ECAM control panel) ... PRESS · APU START pb-sw ... ON · when AVAIL: APU BLEED pb-sw ... ON · X-BLEED ... AUTO · COCKPIT / CABIN TEMP ... AS RQRD · * EXT PWR pb ... AS RQRD
items.quote: Do not use APU BLEED, if the ground personnel confirms that a LP or HP ground air unit is connected to the aircraft.

items.t: ADIRS * ALL IR MODE selector NAV
items.s: Complete alignment: first flight of the day · crew change · departure between 2° N and 2° S · GPS not available and poor NAVAID coverage · GPS not available and flight time more than 3 h
items.quote: A complete IRS alignment must be performed in the following cases: - Before the first flight of the day, or - When there is a crew change, or - When the departure airport is located between latitudes 2 ° north and 2 ° south, or - When the GPS is not available and the NAVAID coverage is poor on the expected route, or - When the GPS is not available and the expected flight time is more than 3 h.

items.s: Set INT LT, FLOOD LT, INTEG LT (glareshield and FCU)
items.quote: Set INT LT, FLOOD LT, INTEG LT (included glareshield and FCU).

items.s: MCDU ... ON (short press of BRT) · MCDU ANNUNCIATOR LIGHTS ... OFF · A/C STATUS ... CHECK · ACTIVE NAV DATABASE ... CYCLE · FMS DATABASE VALIDITY ... CHECK · NAVAID DESELECTION ... AS RQRD · FLIGHT PLAN UPLINK ... REQUEST
items.quote: Short press of the BRT button will switch ON the MCDU, if it is OFF. Use the brightness buttons (BRT and DIM) to adjust the brightness as required.

items.s: ALL EFB ... START · EFB/eQRH VERSION ... CHECK · * EFB STATUS page ... INSERT/CHECK
items.quote: On the EFB STATUS page, each flight crewmember inserts and checks: - ACFT TYPE and ACFT REG - FLT NBR and FROM/TO (in agreement with the FMS ACTIVE/INIT page).

items.s: recalls warnings cleared or cancelled during the last flight
items.quote: This action recalls all the warnings that the flight crew cleared or cancelled during the last flight.

items.s: may be performed later, must be complete by end of Cockpit Preparation
items.quote: The aircraft acceptance can be performed later, but must be completed at the end of the Cockpit Preparation.

items.s: deferred items list · crosscheck with ECAM recall · MEL / CDL acceptability and influence on the flight plan · AIRCRAFT CONFIGURATION SUMMARY ... CHECK (QRH OPS.01A)
items.quote: Check and discuss the MEL items (including the associated operational procedures, if any) and the CDL items. This includes the acceptability of the MEL and CDL items and the influence on the flight plan

items.s: all crewmembers review and discuss applicable OEBs
items.quote: All flight crewmembers review and discuss together all OEBs and associated procedures applicable to the aircraft.

items.s: ATIS ... OBTAIN
items.quote: * ATIS ... OBTAIN CM2-CM3
* JEPPESEN CHARTS ... PREPARE ALL

items.s: flight time ... INSERT · origin and destination ... CHECK
items.quote: * ACARS ... INITIALIZE PF

items.s: per technical condition, NOTAM, runway condition, configuration
items.quote: The flight crew computes the preliminary performance data in accordance with the technical condition of the aircraft and/or any other criteria that may affect the aircraft performance (e.g. NOTAM, runway condition, aircraft configuration).

items.s: * ALL WHITE LIGHTS ... OFF · * RCDR GND CTL pb-sw ... ON · CAPT & PURS/CAPT sw ... CAPT · * STARLINK ... AS RQRD · * RESET BUTTONS (left side) ... CHECK · EXT LT: STROBE ... AUTO · BEACON ... OFF · WING ... OFF · NAV & LOGO ... 1 · NOSE ... OFF · LAND ... OFF · RWY TURN OFF ... OFF · * SIGNS panel ... SET · PROBE/WINDOW HEAT pb-sw ... AUTO · LDG ELEV knob ... AUTO · MAN VALVE SEL ... BOTH · * PACK FLOW ... AUTO · EL/DC pb (ECAM) ... PRESS · BAT 1, BAT 2, APU BAT pb-sw ... OFF then AUTO · T TANK MODE pb-sw ... CHECK AUTO · T TANK FEED selector ... CHECK AUTO · ENG 1 and ENG 2 FIRE pb-sw ... CHECK IN and GUARDED · AGENT 1 and 2 lights ... CHECK OFF · ENG TEST pb ... PRESS and MAINTAIN · ALL LIGHTS ... CHECK · TEMPERATURE selectors ... AS RQRD · FWD COOLING selector ... AS RQRD · PA (3rd occupant) ... RECEPT · CVR TEST pb ... PRESS and MAINTAIN · * RESET BUTTONS (right side) ... CHECK · DATA LOADER ... CHECK OFF
items.quote: As a general rule, during the scan sequence of the overhead panel: * ALL WHITE LIGHTS ... OFF PF

items.s: * ISIS ... CHECK (brightness, IAS, altimeter, attitude, no flags) · * NORTH REF ... CHECK (TRUE blue light off) · DMC selector ... CHECK AUTO · ECAM/ND selector ... CHECK NORM · * CLOCK ... CHECK GPS TIME/SET · LDG GEAR GRVTY EXTN selector ... OFF · * A/SKID & N/W STRG sw ... ON
items.quote: - Adjust brightness. - Check IAS, altimeter readings, altimeter settings and attitude display. - Check no flags - Reset attitude, if necessary.

items.s: RMP 1 and 2 ... CHECK ON · Green NAV light ... CHECK OFF · COM FREQUENCIES ... TUNE · ACP: INT knob ... PRESS OUT/VOLUME CHECK · VHF ... CHECK · HF (if required) ... CHECK · * ACCU PRESS indicator ... CHECK · * PARK BRK handle ... CHECK ON · * BRAKE PRESS indicator ... CHECK · ANN LT selector ... TEST then BRT · COCKPIT DOOR ... CHECK CORRECT OPERATION · MECHANICAL OVERRIDE ... CHECK · * COCKPIT DOOR sw ... NORM · ECAM control panel: All selectors ... CHECK NORM · * THRUST levers ... IDLE · * THRUST REVERSER levers ... STOWED · * ENG MASTER levers ... CHECK OFF · * ENG START selector ... NORM · * ATC ... STBY · * TCAS ... STBY · ALT RPTG ... ON · * ATC SYS ... SELECT · ACARS: * MSG ... ERASE · * ADS ... CHECK ARMED
items.quote: RMP 1 and 2 ... CHECK ON PF Green NAV light ... CHECK OFF PF COM FREQUENCIES ... TUNE PF

items.s: DOOR SD: OXY ... CHECK PRESSURE · MIN FLT CREW OXY CHART ... CHECK PRESSURE · HYD SD: RESERVOIR FLUID LEVEL ... CHECK WITHIN NORMAL RANGE · ENG SD: ENG OIL QUANTITY ... CHECK
items.quote: Check that the oil quantity is above the minimum. Refer to LIM-ENG Oil.
If flight control surface positions do not agree with the control handle positions, check with the maintenance crew before applying hydraulic power.

items.t: SPEED BRAKE * CHECK RETRACTED and DISARMED
items.quote: If flight control surface positions do not agree with the control handle positions, check with the maintenance crew before applying hydraulic power.

items.s: in the green band; blue electric pump to recharge if required
items.quote: The ACCU PRESS indication must be in the green band. If required use the electric pump on blue hydraulic system to recharge the brake accumulator.
The ACCU PRESS indication must be in the green band. If required use the electric pump on blue hydraulic system to recharge the brake accumulator.
The ACCU PRESS indication must be in the green band. If required use the electric pump on blue hydraulic system to recharge the brake accumulator.

items.s: first flight of the day: CHOCKS ... CHECK IN PLACE · PARK BRK handle ... OFF · BRAKE PEDALS ... PRESS · BRAKE PRESSURE ... CHECK · BRAKE PEDALS ... RELEASE · PARK BRK handle ... ON
items.quote: The purpose of this check is to verify, before the first flight of the day, the efficiency of the alternate braking system (absence of “spongy pedals”).

items.s: Life vests · Crash axe · Smoke hoods / portable oxygen and full-face masks · Portable fire extinguisher lockwired, gauge green · Oxygen masks · Flashlights · Escape ropes · PED Fire Containment Bag · Fire gloves
items.quote: - Portable fire extinguisher is lockwired and the pressure gauge indicator is in the green area - Oxygen masks are stowed - Flashlights are stowed - Escape ropes are stowed - PED Fire Containment Bag is stowed - Fire gloves are stowed

items.t: RAIN RPLNT CHECK PRESSURE and QUANTITY
items.quote: Never use rain repellent to wash the windshield and never use it on a dry windshield.

items.t: GEAR PINS (3) * CHECK ONBOARD and STOWED
items.s: three gear pins
items.quote: Check that the three gear pins are onboard and stowed.

items.t: PM: exterior walkaround (PRO-NOR-SOP-05) · PF: cockpit preparation

items.s: * IDLE / PERF FACTOR ... CHECK (DATA A/C STATUS) · INIT A: TO/FROM ... CHECK · ALTN ... ENTER · FLT NBR ... CHECK · COST INDEX ... CHECK · CRZ FL/TEMP ... CHECK · TROPO ... AS RQRD · WINDS ... CHECK · F-PLN: DEPARTURE RWY and SID ... ENTER · ENROUTE WAYPOINTS and AIRWAYS ... CHECK · STEP ALTS ... ENTER · ARRIVAL RWY/APPR and STAR ... ENTER · ETP WAYPOINT(S) ... CREATE · FIX INFO REFERENCE POINT(S) ... ENTER · EQUITIME POINT ... ADJUST · SECONDARY FLIGHT PLAN ... AS APPROPRIATE · RADIO NAV ... CHECK · INIT B: TAXI ... CHECK · RTE RSV / % ... ZERO · ALTN/TIME ... ENTER · FINAL/TIME ... CHECK · ZFW/ZFWCG ... ENTER (if not auto-populated) · BLOCK ... ENTER · EXTRA/TIME ... CHECK · PERF TAKE OFF: SHIFT ... INSERT AS RQRD · THR RED/ACC altitude ... SET or CHECK · ENG OUT ACC altitude ... SET or CHECK · PERF CLB and PERF CRZ: PRESEL speed ... AS RQRD · PERF DES: PRESEL speed ... SET · PROG: BRG / DIST TO ... ENTER · * RNP ... SET or CHECK · * DERATED CLIMB ... AS RQRD · * PRESET SPEEDS ... AS RQRD
items.quote: Press the INIT button on the MCDU to display the INIT A page. Check the TO/FROM field [1R] to confirm the correct flight plan uplink occurred.

items.s: departure route waypoints and constraints · flight plan vs computerized flight plan · initial cruise altitude · total track miles · fuel at destination · performance data · TRANS ALT · SEC F-PLN
items.quote: The PM should have the same mental image of the intended departure procedure, trajectory, and constraints as the PF. The PM should check with the PF if anything is not clear.

items.s: * LOUDSPEAKER knob ... SET · * BAROMETRIC REFERENCE ... SET/CROSSCHECK · * FD ... CHECK ON · * LS ... AS RQRD · * ND MODE and RANGE ... AS RQRD · * ADF/VOR sw ... AS RQRD · FCU: * SPD/MACH window ... DASHED · * HDG-V/S / TRK-FPA pb ... HDG-V/S · * ALT window ... INITIAL EXPECTED CLEARANCE ALTITUDE
items.quote: The maximum difference is: ±20 ft between both PFDs ±60 ft between ISIS and PFDs, 75 ft between PFDs and airport elevation (Refer to PRO-SPO-50 RVSM for more information).

items.t: Lateral consoles · OXYGEN MASK TEST PERFORM
items.s: ECAM DOOR/OXY SD: REGUL LO PR indication ... CHECK NOT DISPLAYED
items.quote: To prevent hearing damage to the ground crew connected to the intercom system, inform them that a loud noise may be heard in the headset when performing the oxygen mask test.

items.s: EFIS DMC selector ... CHECK NORM · PFD and ND brightness knob ... AS RQRD · PFD/ND not transferred · IAS, FMA, initial target ALT, altimeter, VSI, heading, attitude · ND heading, initial waypoint, VOR/ADF
items.quote: - Check IAS, FMA, initial target ALT, altimeter readings, VSI, altimeter settings, heading and attitude display.

items.t: PRESS · STS · FUEL pb PRESS (ECAM control panel)
items.s: * PRESS pb ... PRESS (CAB PRESS SD shows LDG ELEV AUTO) · * STS pb ... PRESS (INOP SYS compatible with MEL) · FUEL pb is the quick reference flow (FUEL SD for the FOB check); FCOM SOP-06 lists PRESS and STS
items.quote: Check that the CAB PRESS SD page displays LDG ELEV AUTO to confirm correct position of the LDG ELEV knob.

items.t: RLS VERSION / FITNESS / FOB / PDSC ... SENT
items.s: via OPS CTRL MSG page in ACARS
items.quote: Electronically accept latest flight release version fitness for duty, Fuel on Board and PDSC time via OPS CTRL MSG page in ACARS.

items.s: POSITION MONITOR: IRS in NAV, each IRS within 5 NM of FMS position · ND ROSE-NAV or ARC consistent with airport, SID, NAVAIDs
items.quote: On the POSITION MONITOR page, check that the IRS are in NAV mode, and check that the distance between each IRS and the FMS position is lower than 5 NM.

items.s: ECAM FOB = block fuel of the computerized flight plan · FUEL SD: balanced, CG within limits
items.quote: - Check that ECAM FOB corresponds to the block fuel of the computerized flight plan - On FUEL SD page, check that the fuel is correctly balanced and CG is within operational limits.

items.s: VHF, ACARS (PDC) or CPDLC (DCL)
items.quote: Obtain ATC clearance via VHF, ACARS (PDC) or via CPDLC (DCL), Refer to PRO-SUP-46 Departure Clearance via CPDLC.

items.s: FMS waypoints vs Dispatch Release, Jeppesen Charts, ATC clearance
items.quote: The Departure Legs Verification is designed to verify the FMS waypoints against the Dispatch Release, the Jeppesen Charts, and ATC Clearance (if available).

items.t: DEPARTURE BRIEFING * PERFORM (TRIGGER: Cockpit Preparation checklist)
items.s: Threat Based Departure Briefing (FOM Threat Based Departure Briefing/TPC)
items.quote: Perform a Threat Based Departure Briefing. For more information, refer to FOM "Threat Based Departure Briefing/ TPC".

items.s: FMS uploads the ACARS final weight data and takeoff performance
items.quote: The PF selects the “*LOAD FMC” prompt when it appears. This will allow the FMS to upload the ACARS final weight data and takeoff performance.

items.s: Flight number / date · Aircraft · Crew Count · TOF · TOW vs planned (MIN RLS FUEL adjustment?) · TOB · Jumpseat · ZFW/ZFWCG · NOTOC · AVI · FAM
items.quote: Both crew members carefully check the Load Closeout data is correct: - Flight number / date - Aircraft - Crew Count - Takeoff Fuel (“TOF”)

items.s: green dot, F, S, VLS are computed from the entered ZFW and ZFWCG
items.quote: The characteristic speeds displayed on the MCDU (green dot, F, S, VLS) are computed from the ZFW and ZFWCG entered by the crew on the MCDU. Therefore, this data must be carefully checked before departure.

items.t: LOAD CLOSEOUT (MACTOW) CG and ECAM CG CHECK
items.s: difference less than 2 %: rely on ECAM CG · more than 2 %: check ZFW and ZFWCG in the MCDU, then rely on ECAM CG
items.quote: If there is more than 2 % difference, check that the ZFW and the ZFWCG have been correctly inserted in the MCDU, then rely on ECAM CG.

items.s: CM2: PASSENGER & JUMPSEAT COUNT ... ANNOUNCE · CM1: JETPACK FLIGHT DECK REPORT ... VERIFY · CM2: FLIGHT NUMBER & TAIL NUMBER ... ANNOUNCE · CM1: DISPATCH RELEASE ... VERIFY · CM2: REMARKS ... ANNOUNCE (HAZMAT, pets in cargo) · count discrepancy: contact Central Load Planning
items.quote: Read out loud the passenger count and jumpseat numbers from the Load Closeout.

items.s: ECAM FOB above Minimum Release Fuel
items.quote: Check that ECAM FOB is above Minimum Release Fuel on the flight plan.

items.t: TAKEOFF PERFORMANCE ... UPLINK FLX or UPLINK TOGA
items.s: FLAPS/THS reminder ... INSERT · manual entry: T.O SHIFT, V1 VR V2, FLX TO TEMP, THR RED/ACC, ENG OUT ACC
items.quote: The PF uplinks the Takeoff Data into the FMS PERF TO page. The crew can select to uplink either FLX or TOGA takeoff data.

items.t: FINAL TAKEOFF DATA (TPR/TLR) CHECK · FMS TAKEOFF DATA CHECK/REVISE (PF, then PM)
items.s: Aircraft / Flight number / date · Wind / OAT / QNH · FINAL TPR (or TLR still valid) · Remarks · Takeoff Runway / Intersection · Engine Out Departure Procedure · Air Conditioning on/off · V speeds · Flap Config/THS · Flex / TOGA · GTOW vs MTOW · then each pilot compares the FMS takeoff data with the printed TPR/TLR (an uplink deletes THR RED / ACCEL ALT) · intersection: T.O SHIFT inserted
items.quote: Both crew members carefully check the Final Takeoff Performance Report (TPR/TLR) data is correct:

items.s: PF: FMS PERF TO page ... SELECT · PM: FMS F-PLN page ... SELECT
items.quote: It is recommended to display the PERF TAKEOFF page on the PF side.

items.t: SEATS, SEAT BELTS, HARNESSES, RUDDER PEDALS, ARMRESTS ... ADJUST
items.s: eyes aligned with the red and white balls
items.quote: The seat is correctly adjusted when the flight crew’s eyes are aligned with the red and white balls.

items.t: PITOT COVERS REMOVED · AIR CONDITIONING UNITS CHECK DISCONNECTED · EXT PWR
items.s: EXT PWR pb ... CHECK AVAIL · EXT PWR DISCONNECTION ... REQUEST (before start if needed for pushback/start)
items.quote: PITOT COVERS ... REMOVED PF

items.s: ATC pushback/start clearance and ground crew clearance
items.quote: Obtain ATC pushback/start clearance and ground crew clearance.
When cleared for start or pushback, set the BEACON sw to ON.
ATC is set in accordance with airport requirements.

items.s: sliding window handle fully forward, red indicator not visible · ECAM: all doors closed · cockpit door closed and locked
items.quote: - Check, on the ECAM lower display, that all the aircraft doors are closed - When required by FOM policies, check that the cockpit door is closed and locked (no cockpit door open/fault indication).

items.s: ECAM lower display
items.quote: Check, on the ECAM lower display, that all slides are armed.

The engines start regardless of the thrust lever position. If the thrust levers are not set to IDLE, then thrust rapidly increases to the corresponding thrust lever position, causing a hazardous situation.

items.t: PARK BRK handle ON (if pushback not required)
items.s: ACCU PRESS indicator ... CHECK · BRAKES PRESS indicator ... CHECK
items.quote: When one brake temperature is above 300 °C , avoid applying the parking brake, unless operationally necessary.

items.t: Pushback required · PARK BRK handle ON · N/WS DISC MEMO CHECK DISPLAYED
items.s: tow pin in the tow position shows the N/WS DISC memo · no memo but pin confirmed: do not start engines during pushback
items.quote: If the ECAM does not display the N/WS DISC memo, but the ground crew confirms that the tow pin is in the towing position, do not start the engines during pushback in order to avoid possible damage to the nose landing gear upon green hydraulic pressurization.

items.t: Pushback · PARK BRK handle OFF on ground crew clearance · no brakes during pushback
items.s: pushback complete: PARK BRK handle ... ON · BRAKE PRESS indicator ... CHECK · “CLEARED TO DISCONNECT” ... ANNOUNCE
items.quote: The parking brake is released upon clearance from the ground crew. For the pushback procedure and communication script, refer to the FOM.

items.t: CA becomes PF if both pilots not trained (quickref).
THRUST levers IDLE · ENG START selector IGN START
items.s: lower ECAM shows the ENGINE SD page · engines start regardless of thrust lever position
items.quote: ENG START selector ... IGN START PF

items.t: PF: “ENGINE 1 START” · ENG 1 MASTER lever ON
items.s: engine 1 first: powers the blue hydraulic system (parking brake) · after all amber crosses and messages have disappeared on the engine parameters
items.quote: Engine 1 is usually started first. It powers the blue hydraulic system, which pressurizes the parking brake.

items.s: ISA sea level: EPR about 1.015 · N1 about 22.6 % · N2 about 47 % · N3 about 63 % · EGT about 380 °C · FF about 1 800 lb/h
items.quote: ENG IDLE PARAMETERS ... CHECK PF

items.t: All engine taxi · PF: “ENGINE 2 START” · ENG 2 MASTER lever ON
items.s: same procedure as engine 1
items.quote: Apply the same procedure as indicated for engine 1.

items.t: PF sets ENG START selector to NORM

items.s: warm-up: idle at least 5 min cold (3 min warm) before high power
items.quote: After start, to avoid thermal shock, the engine must be operated at idle, or near idle for at least 5 min when engines are cold (3 min when engines are warm after a stop of 1.5 h or less) before advancing the thrust lever to high power.

items.s: all engine taxi: AUTO · one engine taxi: OPEN to supply both packs with engine 1
items.quote: For All Engine Taxi, the cross bleed valve remains in AUTO. For One Engine Taxi, open the cross bleed valve in order to supply both packs with engine 1.
GND SPLRS ... ARM PM

items.s: avoids ingestion of engine exhaust gases
items.quote: This action enables to avoid ingestion of engine exhaust gases.

items.t: RUD TRIM RESET pb PRESS · RUD TRIM CHECK NEUTRAL
items.s: up to 0.6° residual is normal
items.quote: After the reset, the flight crew may observe an indication of up to 0.6 ° (L or R) in the RUD TRIM position indication.

items.t: ENG 1 and 2 ANTI-ICE pb-sw AS RQRD
items.s: ON for all ground operations in icing conditions
items.quote: Engine anti-ice must be set to ON during all ground operations, when icing conditions exist or are anticipated.

items.t: FLAPS lever SET FOR TAKEOFF · FLAPS CHECK POSITION
items.s: icing with rain, slush or snow: keep flaps retracted until the holding point
items.quote: Maintain the flaps retracted until the aircraft reaches the holding point of the takeoff runway. This action prevents contamination of the slats/flaps mechanism.

items.s: on ground the valves open about 30 s for the self-test, then close while on ground
items.quote: On ground when wing anti-ice is switched on, the anti-ice valves open for about 30 s for self-test sequence, then close as long as the aircraft is on ground.

items.t: APU MASTER SW pb-sw OFF (if not required)
items.quote: If the APU is not required: APU MASTER SW pb-sw ... OFF PF

items.s: takeoff CG vs ECAM CG indication
items.quote: Check the takeoff CG on the PITCH TRIM wheel using the CG indication on the ECAM.

items.s: PM checks, PF crosschecks: no STS reminder
items.quote: The PM checks and the PF crosschecks that there is no status reminder (STS) on the E/WD

items.t: N/WS DISC MEMO CHECK NOT DISPLAYED
items.quote: N/WS DISC MEMO ... CHECK NOT DISPLAYED PF

items.s: E/WD FLEX temperature vs FMS PERF page
items.quote: The PF crosschecks the thrust setting (e.g. FLEX temperature) displayed on the E/WD with the FMS PERF page.

items.t: NWS TOWING FAULT LIGHT CHECK OFF
items.quote: NWS TOWING FAULT LIGHT ... CHECK OFF PF

items.s: PF: NOSE sw TAXI · RWY TURN OFF ON · PARK BRK handle OFF · BRAKES PRESSURE CHECK AT ZERO (slight residual pressure is normal for a short time)
items.quote: The flight crew may observe slight residual pressure on the triple indicator for a short period of time.

items.s: when taxi clearance obtained
items.quote: When taxi clearance obtained CLEAR LEFT (RIGHT) CLEAR RIGHT (LEFT)

items.s: BRAKE PEDALS ... PRESS · BRAKES ... CHECK · PM: BRAKE FAN AS RQRD · BRAKES PRESSURE ... CHECK AT ZERO
items.quote: If the aircraft was parked in wet conditions for a long time, the first brake application at low speed is less effective.

items.s: PM: “FULL UP, FULL DOWN, NEUTRAL” · “FULL LEFT, FULL RIGHT, NEUTRAL” · PF: “RUDDER” PM: “FULL LEFT, FULL RIGHT, NEUTRAL” (PM follows pedals with feet)
items.quote: Check the flight controls at a convenient stage, before or during taxi.

items.s: review before checking the AFS/Flight Instruments
items.quote: Review the ATC clearance before checking the AFS/Flight Instruments

items.s: CLEARED ALTITUDE ON FCU ... CHECK · HDG ON FCU ... IF REQUIRED, PRESET · BOTH FD ... CHECK ON · PFD/ND ... CHECK (both): airspeeds, initial target altitude, heading, FMA modes, ND SID per the departure
items.quote: If a heading is required by ATC after takeoff, in the case of a radar vector departure, preset the heading on the FCU. NAV mode will be disarmed.

items.s: radar on the PF side, TERR ON ND on the PM side
items.quote: Consider selecting the radar display on the PF side, and TERR ON ND on the PM side only.
AUTO BRK MAX pb-sw ... ON PM
ATC CODE/MODE ... CONFIRM/SET FOR TAKEOFF PM

items.s: IGN/START: heavy rain, moderate or severe turbulence expected after takeoff
items.quote: Select IGN/START if: - Heavy rain, or - Moderate turbulence, or - Severe turbulence is expected after takeoff.

items.t: WXR/PWS sw SYS 1(2) · CAPT and F/O DISPLAY ALL
items.s: 30 s to fill the radar 3D buffer
items.quote: 30 s are necessary for the 3D buffer of the radar to be filled.

items.s: EWD displays T.O CONFIG NORMAL memo
items.quote: Press the T.O CONFIG on the ECP, and check that the EWD displays the T.O CONFIG NORMAL memo.
Check that the EWD does not display any blue line in the T.O memo section.

items.t: Cabin NA/ADVISED · PM PA: “[FLIGHT ATTENDANTS SHOULD NOW] BE SEATED FOR TAKEOFF”
items.s: no less than two minutes prior to takeoff
items.quote: On Pax aircraft, The PM will make the Takeoff PA no less than two minutes prior to takeoff stating "[FLIGHT ATTENDANTS SHOULD NOW] BE SEATED FOR TAKEOFF".

items.w: T.O CONFIG pb pressed and Takeoff Advisory PA complete

items.s: Aerodata inputs (runway and environmental) correct · new TPR: gross weight into PTOW (LSK 5R) of the AOC TO Conditions page, then SEND (LSK 6R)
items.quote: The PM ensures the Aerodata inputs (runway and environmental) are correct and if required, sends for a new TPR.

items.s: takeoff data, runway and/or SID · ATC clearance agrees with the FMS if NAV mode is used · any slats/flaps configuration change
items.quote: The PM revises the FMS as necessary, including the takeoff data, runway and/or SID, as applicable.

items.s: TPR/TLR performance data vs the FMS PERF page
items.quote: The PF crosschecks the revised FMS, as applicable. The PF checks the TPR/TLR performance data with the FMS PERF page.

items.t: FLAPS lever SET · FCU ALT SET · T.O CONFIG pb TEST
items.s: takeoff position · cleared altitude crosschecked on the PFD · EWD shows T.O CONFIG NORMAL
items.quote: On the PFD, crosscheck and confirm the cleared altitude.
RE-BRIEFING ... PERFORM BOTH

items.s: Taxi: Nose TAXI · Rwy Turnoff ON · Crossing a runway: Strobes ON · Land ON
STROBE sw ... ON · LAND LIGHT sw ... ON
items.quote: When crossing a runway: STROBE sw ... ON PF LAND LIGHT sw ... ON PF
